text: Free prop hunt demo, but there are no props to pick.
You're a cube, and you have to build your own disguise.
Model it, paint it, and blend into the room before the Busters come looking.
Hide close to a hunter and you score double. Bigger disguise, bigger payout.
Best part: watching someone pass off a wobbly block sculpture as a book on a shelf.
The catch? If you're bad at building, you'll get caught instantly.
The demo is about six hundred megabytes, in fourteen languages.
Think Garry's Mod prop hunt, built in Minecraft.
Worth a dip with friends who can't draw.
